UN R999 (version 1.0.0)
Introduction (for information)
This Regulation combines the provisions of Regulations Nos. 7 and 23 into a single Regulation.
1 Scope
This Regulation applies to rear lamps of vehicles of categories M and N.
2. Definitions
For the purposes of this Regulation:
2.1. "Lamp" means a device designed to illuminate the road or to emit a light signal.
3. Administrative provisions
3.1. The device shall bear the trade name.

=== PDF page 2 ===
UN R999, version 1.0.0 | page 2 of 3
5. Specifications
5.1. Each lamp shall emit red light and shall meet the requirements of paragraph 2.1. and Annex 3
when tested with the light sources listed in the following table:
